title: Law to give nonprofits first chance to buy distressed buildings
summary: This bill would let certain HPD-certified nonprofits or nonprofit-led joint ventures get a first opportunity to submit a statement of interest and to purchase certain distressed residential buildings before they go on the open market. Owners of properties meeting distress criteria, such as chronic code violations or expiring affordability restrictions, would have to notify HPD and qualified entities before selling, giving those entities 20 days to express interest and 70 days to make an offer, plus a right of first refusal on outside offers. Owners could seek an exemption for undue financial hardship, and the law would take effect one year after enactment.
